(Currently Amended) 1. An apparatus, comprising: an encoder (300) for encoding mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence, and wherein the encoder is configured to adapt the mode mapping information based on at least one of coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence, a selected subset of a set of adapted mode mapping information relating to at least a portion of the sequence, statistics of one or more pictures in the sequence, and statistics of the sequence.

(Currently Amended) 17.
